description: Run every safety check on a withdrawal from a Mamo Account: ownership, enough in it, dust left behind, lending-market cash, and a dry run on Base. Needs `account` and `amount` or `all: true`, never both. A stocks portfolio sells on Aerodrome for cash (`maxSlippageBps`) or exits `inKind`. Call this FIRST and pass its `previewId` to `prepare_withdraw`; nothing is signed or sent here.

accountAddress.description: Stocks: a stocks portfolio this wallet owns, by address. Default: the one the reads show.

address.description: The wallet that owns the Account and will sign, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

all.description: Withdraw everything. Prefer this over naming the full balance: it uses `withdrawAll()`, which cannot revert on a rounding remainder.

amount.description: How much, as a plain decimal string in the Account's own token. Or set `all` to close the position.

inKind.description: Stocks: take holdings out as they are, unsold.

maxSlippageBps.description: Stocks, cash: max slippage per sale, bps (default 100).

token.description: Stocks, inKind + amount: which holding. Default USDC.

name: preview_withdraw
title: Check a withdrawal before building it
